newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Deutsche Bank to issue Lion, Carter call warrants.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank to issue Lion, Carter call warrants.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG said on Monday it would issue call warrants over ordinary shares in Lion Nathan Ltd and Carter Holt Harvey.
Trading of the warrants will begin on the New Zealand Stock Exchange on April 1, 1997.
Last month Deutsche Bank issued call warrants for Telecom shares and for each of the four Fletcher Challenge stocks.

"The success of Deutsche Bank's Telecom and Fletcher Challenge warrant issues shows wide acceptance of warrants in New Zealand," said Robert Gipslis of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Securities, co-ordinator for the issue.
The Carter Holt warrants allow an investor to buy one share in Carter upon exercise of two warrants and payment of NZ$3.90 per share at any time before the warrants expire on November 26, 1998.
The Lion Nathan warrants are similar, except they expire on December 17, 1998 and require payment of $4.20 per share upon exercise of two warrants.
The initial offering period will start on March 24.
